doc: Films on exact frame and sample counts: render a description to WebM, Y4M, PNG or WAV, take a still, check a description, probe a file, show the timing. A view's frames are omui's, through a composition that adds them.

tools.name: video.render
tools.description: A video rendered to files on exact frame and sample counts: WebM (VP9 and Opus), Y4M (and a WAV beside it), a PNG sequence, or a WAV

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.xdef.ts, or its .json) (or, where a composition adds omui's view source, a view document *.view.xdef.json)

out.description: a file or directory path: x.webm, x.y4m, x.wav, shots/{:05}.png or shots/

format.description: webm, y4m, png or wav (default: from out)

bitrate.description: WebM: a target bit rate (kbps) instead of a quality

threads.description: WebM: encoder threads (1, the default, gives the same bytes everywhere)

tools.name: video.still
tools.description: One frame of a video as a PNG

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.xdef.ts, or its .json) (or, where a composition adds omui's view source, a view document *.view.xdef.json)

out.description: a file or directory path: the PNG

at.description: the frame shown at a time, seconds

tools.name: video.check
tools.description: Whether a video description reads: its problems, or its size, rate, frames and samples

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.xdef.ts, or its .json) (or, where a composition adds omui's view source, a view document *.view.xdef.json)

tools.name: video.probe
tools.description: What a WebM, Y4M or WAV file holds (a WebM decoded: its frames and samples counted)

file.description: a file or directory path: a .webm, .y4m or .wav file

tools.name: video.timing
tools.description: Each frame's first sample and length, and its start in nanoseconds
